chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Sinan, from 'Anbasah ibn Mus'ab, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who urinates in flowing water. He said: There is no harm in it if the water is flowing.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.إِذَا كَانَ الْمَاءُ جَارِيًا: when the water is flowing; the condition attached to the ruling
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is not objectionable

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on urinating in flowing water according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning urinating in flowing water. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no objection to it when the water is flowing, indicating a distinction in fiqh between flowing and non-flowing water.
